name: Incendiary Cloud

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A 20-foot-radius cloud of embers: Heavily Obscured, Dex save or 10d8 Fire (half on a success); it drifts 10 feet away from you each turn.
text: Creatures in the cloud when it appears save, and so does a creature the cloud moves onto, that enters it or ends its turn in it, once per turn. At the start of each of your turns the cloud moves 10 feet away from you; a strong wind disperses it.
